name: jrebirth-jpms-module
description: Author and fix the JPMS module-info.java of any Java module that uses JRebirth: requires, exports, opens for reflection, the generated ModuleStarter provider, and ServiceLoader uses/provides. Use when creating a new JRebirth module, when JavaFX or JRebirth reflection fails at runtime (IllegalAccessException, "does not open"), or when a module is not picked up (ModuleStarter missing).
